stem.text: One of the glycoproteins present in the cell surface membrane of human cells is called ICAM-1.
ICAM-1 is a cell adhesion molecule and it is also used by the common cold virus to attach to human cells.
Which statements are true about ICAM-1?

items: A drug binding to ICAM-1 to block the common cold virus could stop cells attaching to each other.
Part of the ICAM-1 structure must be complementary to proteins in the coat of the common cold virus.
The ICAM-1 structure must have hydrophobic parts to stabilise it within the cell membrane.
